reciprocal.why: A019 works through Nicomachean Ethics IV.7: truthfulness as the mean between boasting and mock modesty in how a person describes themselves.

reciprocal.link: A056 — Recognise akrasia — weakness of will
reciprocal.why: A056 sets out Aristotle's reply to Socrates in Nicomachean Ethics VII: why acting against one's own judgement is possible, and the two ways it happens.
A059 shows how Aristotle tells a lapse of will from settled vice, using choice, regret and self-awareness.

A095 traces Aristotle's claim that contemplation is the most self-sufficient activity, and his limits on it: bodily needs, moderate means, and a self-sufficiency that includes family and fellow citizens.
